title: from_credentials panic is redundant and masks startup path contract
description: reader Config::validate() already checks every auth.users password before build_credential_store() is called, which calls from_credentials(). from_credentials() panics on the same condition. Any future caller path that constructs a CredentialStore from validated data without going through Config::from_file() (e.g. a test helper, a future HTTP config reload path) will panic instead of returning Err. The panic is a surprise at a call site that might reasonably expect an error return. Document the precondition explicitly or convert to Result.
